# OPIS-Manager

> Angular single-page app that visualizes OPIS (Opinione Studenti) student course-evaluation results for the University of Catania (UNICT). Browse evaluations by academic year, department (Dipartimento), course (CDS), and teaching (Insegnamento); compare across years; and read the computed V1/V2/V3 quality scores via charts. Live: https://unict-dmi.github.io/OPIS-Manager/

## Tech stack

- Angular 21 with standalone components (no NgModules), signals, OnPush change detection
- TypeScript 5.9, RxJS 7
- Charts: ng2-charts + chart.js 4, boxplot plugin (@sgratzl/chartjs-chart-boxplot), chartjs-plugin-annotation
- UI extras: @angular/cdk, @angular-slider/ngx-slider (year range), gsap (animations)
- Tooling: Angular CLI 21 / @angular/build, Vitest (unit tests), ESLint 9 + @angular-eslint, Prettier
- Node 24+

## System context

This is the frontend only. It is one piece of a three-repo system (sibling folders under `OPIS/`):
- `opis-manager-core` - Laravel/PHP REST API serving OPIS data (this app's backend)
- `opis-manager-scraper` - PHP scraper that pulls the official UNICT OPIS site into the database
- `OPIS-Manager` (this repo) - Angular client

API base is configured in `src/environment.ts` (`api_url`, default `https://open-job-dmi.unictdev.org/opis-api/api`). v2 endpoints used: `/v2/dipartimento`, `/v2/dipartimento/with-id/{id}/cds`, `/v2/cds/with-id/{id}/insegnamenti`, `/v2/cds/coarse/{unict_id}/schedeopis`, `/v2/insegnamento/coarse/{code}/schedeopis`, `/v2/questions`.

## Architecture

Standalone-component app. Routes in `src/app/app.routes.ts`: `''` (home / departments), `formula`, `info`, `login`, `department/:depsName`. Providers (HttpClient, Router, charts) in `src/app/app.config.ts`.

Smart page components live in `src/app/pages/` (home, department, formula, info, login); the `department` page holds the bulk of the data-loading and chart logic. Presentational pieces are split into `src/app/ui/sections/` (header-nav, footer, year-section, year-stats, cds-selected-section), `src/app/ui/cards/`, and `src/app/ui/shared/` (graph, loader, select, year-range, animated logo, icon).

Data access is in `src/app/services/` (departments, cds, teachings, questions, graph, auth, analytics, github, icon-registry). Scores: `graph` service computes V1/V2/V3 as weighted sums of questionnaire answer frequencies times per-question weights; question groups are defined in `src/app/enums/opis-group.enum.ts` and weights in `weights.enum.ts`. `src/app/mappers/graph.mapper.ts` reshapes API responses into per-year structures for the charts.

Domain models are in `src/app/interfaces/` (department, cds, teaching, opis-record/SchedaOpis, question). Static config/constants in `src/app/values/` (academic years, thresholds, department id maps, chart button config, disclaimers, contributors).

## Key paths

- `src/app/app.routes.ts`, `src/app/app.config.ts`, `src/app/app.ts` - bootstrap, routing, providers
- `src/app/pages/department/` - main detail view (CDS / teaching results, charts)
- `src/app/services/` - API access + score computation (graph service is the formula engine)
- `src/app/interfaces/` - domain models
- `src/app/enums/` - chart typologies, V1/V2/V3 groups, answer weights
- `src/app/mappers/graph.mapper.ts` - API -> grouped-by-year transform
- `src/app/values/` - constants (years, thresholds, department maps, contributors)
- `src/environment.ts` / `src/environment.development.ts` - API + GitHub URLs, GA config
- TS path aliases: `@services`, `@interfaces`, `@sections`, `@shared-ui`, etc. (see tsconfig.json)

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm start              # ng serve on :4200
npm run build          # production build
npm run watch          # dev build, watch mode
npm test               # vitest (with coverage)
npm run lint           # ng lint
npm run lint:fix       # ng lint --fix
npm run format         # prettier --write src
```

## Deployment

GitHub Pages via CI (`.github/workflows/`). Push to `master` deploys the current app to the site root; the legacy `old` branch deploys under `/old/`. Coverage thresholds are enforced at 75%.

## Conventions

- Standalone components only; prefer signals and OnPush; use the configured TS path aliases for imports.
- New API calls go through a service in `src/app/services/`, typed against an interface in `src/app/interfaces/`.
- Tunable constants (academic years, score thresholds, department maps) belong in `src/app/values/`, not inline.
